IIThe story

What the film covers.

01 · Compose-first at scale

Teams hesitate to rewrite stable, heavily optimized UI. On migrated Instagram Direct surfaces, Compose cut UI code by 50%.

02 · Strategic migration

Small Compose pieces inside a big View codebase pay a bridging cost. So the team migrated whole surfaces, under A/B tests, with no visible change for users.

03 · Proven performance

Billions of messages a day. Google and Meta co-engineered the fixes: about 13% fewer large frame drops in Meta's internal testing, now in Compose for every developer.

The AI payoff 35% less AI agent execution time32% fewer engineer–agent exchangesper character of landed code 33% lower token costper agent session
